<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $threshold = 5;
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $timeout = 30;
    private $state = 'closed';

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'open' && (time() - $this->lastFailureTime) > $this->timeout) {
            $this->state = 'half-open';
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'closed';
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'open';
        }
    }
}

class NotificationService {
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $fallbackQueue = [];

    public function __construct(CircuitBreaker $cb) {
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
    }

    public function sendNotification(string $recipient, string $subject, string $body, array $metadata = []): bool {
        if ($this->circuitBreaker->getState() === 'open') {
            $this->fallbackQueue[] = compact('recipient', 'subject', 'body', 'metadata');
            return false;
        }

        try {
            $result = $this->dispatchEmail($recipient, $subject, $body, $metadata);
            if ($result) {
                $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            } else {
                $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            }
            return $result;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return false;
        }
    }

    private function dispatchEmail(string $to, string $subject, string $body, array $metadata): bool {
        $headers = $this->buildHeaders($to, $metadata);
        $sanitizedSubject = $this->sanitizeHeaderValue($subject);
        return mail($to, $sanitizedSubject, $body, $headers);
    }

    private function buildHeaders(string $recipient, array $metadata): string {
        $headers = "MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n";
        $headers .= "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\r\n";
        
        $fromAddress = $this->resolveFromAddress($metadata);
        $headers .= "From: " . $fromAddress . "\r\n";

        if (isset($metadata['reply_to'])) {
            $headers .= "Reply-To: " . $this->sanitizeHeaderValue($metadata['reply_to']) . "\r\n";
        }

        if (isset($metadata['priority'])) {
            $headers .= "X-Priority: " . $this->sanitizeHeaderValue($metadata['priority']) . "\r\n";
        }

        return $headers;
    }

    private function resolveFromAddress(array $metadata): string {
        if (isset($metadata['from_name']) && isset($metadata['from_email'])) {
            $name = $this->encodeDisplayName($metadata['from_name']);
            $email = $this->sanitizeHeaderValue($metadata['from_email']);
            if (!filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
                return "noreply@example.com";
            }
            return $name . " <" . $email . ">";
        }
        return "noreply@example.com";
    }

    private function encodeDisplayName(string $name): string {
        // RFC 2047 encoding for display names
        if (preg_match('/[^\x20-\x7E]/', $name)) {
            return '=?UTF-8?B?' . base64_encode($name) . '?=';
        }
        return '"' . addcslashes($name, '"\\') . '"';
    }

    private function sanitizeHeaderValue(string $value): string {
        return str_replace(array("\r", "\n"), '', $value);
    }
}

class WebSocketHandler {
    private $notificationService;
    private $connections = [];

    public function __construct() {
        $cb = new CircuitBreaker();
        $this->notificationService = new NotificationService($cb);
    }

    public function onMessage($connection, string $payload): void {
        $data = json_decode($payload, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['action'])) {
            $connection->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid payload']));
            return;
        }

        switch ($data['action']) {
            case 'notify':
                $this->handleNotify($connection, $data);
                break;
            case 'subscribe':
                $this->handleSubscribe($connection, $data);
                break;
        }
    }

    private function handleNotify($connection, array $data): void {
        $recipient = filter_var($data['recipient'] ?? '', FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL);
        if (!$recipient) {
            $connection->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid recipient']));
            return;
        }

        $subject = $data['subject'] ?? 'Notification';
        $body = $data['body'] ?? '';
        $metadata = $data['metadata'] ?? [];

        $result = $this->notificationService->sendNotification($recipient, $subject, $body, $metadata);
        $connection->send(json_encode(['success' => $result]));
    }

    private function handleSubscribe($connection, array $data): void {
        $channel = $data['channel'] ?? 'default';
        $this->connections[$channel][] = $connection;
        $connection->send(json_encode(['subscribed' => $channel]));
    }
}
